claims.value: Dayhoff is a hybrid state-space Mamba and Transformer self-attention model with Mixture-of-Experts modules for protein sequence generation. It supports zero-shot mutation effect prediction, scaffold design, and guided generation. Trained on the Dayhoff Atlas protein data.
claims.evidence: Hybrid state-space-model transformer architecture with mixture-of-experts... natively predict zero-shot mutation effects on fitness... scaffold structural motifs
pipeline_tag: text-generation... Dayhoff is intended for broad research use on protein language modeling... generation of novel proteins
